symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1775 follow-up: `drop user role X` while a demo user holds X passed check and exec; `mx check` then reported [CE1613] "The selected user role 'X' no longer exists." at Demo user (measured on 11.12.6).
cause: execDropUserRole removed the role without following its inbound references; demo users store their roles by name.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_security_write.go (execDropUserRole refuses holders, demoUserRoleDropRefusal), mdl/executor/validate_grant_refs.go (check tracks each demo user's roles through the script: create sets, create or modify adds, drop removes)
insight: A demo user's roles only grow (`create or modify demo user` merges), so the refusal can only point at dropping the demo user — the script view must model that union, or `create or modify` with other roles would wrongly clear the refusal. Same class as ako/mxcli#2015 (AdminUserRole); the remaining inbound reference to a user role is GuestUserRole.
